correctness.rationale: For n>=3 Segre decomposable points of span<=2 have at most two distinct values or three points on a line. Quadratic generators force the latter entire line inside Segre, and its lines vary exactly one tensor factor. Hence components are the r ruling families L_j and 2^(n-1)-1 two-value E_S, closed irreducible and mutually not contained by dense-open arguments. Pairwise intersections of distinct E_S and L_j are the small diagonal, while E_S∩L_j=B_j×(P^{m_j})^2. Stratifying L_j into diagonal and unique-line incidence (P1)^n minus diagonal, then scissor inclusion-exclusion, gives the displayed K_0(Var) class for arbitrary characteristic; component dimensions imply equidimensionality iff m_j all equal and n=D-m+2. Exhaustive independent prime-field counts matched 261,729,928,1449,2295. The statements are for reduced loci, not minors schemes.
